'''''Koh-Lanta: Palau''''' is the tenth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from August 28 to October 30, 2009, with each episode airing at 8:55&nbsp;p.m.

[[Christina Chevry]] defeated [[Patrick Merle]] in a 5-2 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

== Production ==
This season took place in the island country of Palau within the geographic region of Micronesia. The main theme of the season was the Pacific Theatre of World War II, similar to that of {{S|10}}, the American season which was filmed in the same location.

==Twists==
* '''Expanded Cast:''' This is the first season to have its initial cast comprising of eighteen castaways.
* '''Elimination Challenge:''' On Day 1, an elimination challenge occurred where one man and one woman would be eliminated. The winning man and woman would select one castaway to join them to learn essential survival skills.
* '''[[Schoolyard Pick]]:''' The [[tribe]]s were created on Day 3 and were selected by the youngest and oldest castaways.
* '''Replacements:''' Due to three [[evacuation]]s, three players ([[Anthony Parra]], Christina and [[Kader Rebaï]]) returned to the game after being voted out.
* '''Tribe Switch:''' As part of the [[Reward Challenge]] on Day 10, the winning tribe won the right to take one of their opposing tribe's members. However, the result of the challenge was a tie, ultimately resulting in both tribes taking one member each.
* '''Re-entry Challenge:''' As a result of the new [[Ambassadors|ambassador]] format (the castaway chosen being eliminated instead of having an extra vote cast against them) being heavily disliked by the castaways, the castaway eliminated by the ambassadors would compete in a re-entry challenge for a chance to return to the game.
